info.title: OpenWrench Internal Teams API
info.description:
External partners API for OpenWrench supplier inventory: purchase requests, purchase orders, receipts, parts, equipment types, vendors, stock locations, per-stock-location inventory, and work order part/equipment usage.

## Authentication
Every request must include an API key in the `X-API-KEY` header. Requests with a missing or invalid key receive `401 Unauthorized`. All data is scoped to the supplier company/facility of the contact the API key belongs to.

## Rate limiting
Each API key is limited to 10 requests per 20-second window. Requests beyond that receive `429 Too Many Requests`.

## Response envelope
Single-entity responses are wrapped as `{ "type": "<EntityName>", "data": { ... }, "status": "ok" }`. List responses are wrapped as `{ "type": "<EntityName>", "data": [ ... ], "count": <total>, "status": "ok" }` where `count` is the total number of matching records. Count endpoints return `{ "type": "Count", "data": <integer>, "status": "ok" }`. Errors are returned as `{ "message": "...", "type": "<ExceptionType>", "status": "error", "traceId": "..." }` with HTTP status 400 (bad input), 401 (missing/invalid key), 404 (not found), or 429 (rate limited).

## Pagination and filtering
List endpoints accept `offset`, `limit` (default 10, max 25), `sort_by`, and `order` (`asc`|`desc`) query parameters. Any other query parameter is passed through as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column.

## Date formats
Date-time fields serialize as strings in one of two shapes depending on the underlying type: ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. `2026-08-14T13:05:22.000-07:00`) for most timestamps, or `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.S` (space-separated, no offset) for database timestamp fields. Plain dates are `yyyy-MM-dd`. When sending date-times, ISO 8601 is accepted.

## API keys
These endpoints require a **partner API key**, which is separate from buyer and supplier API keys. A buyer API key will not authenticate against `/v1/partners/` endpoints. Contact support@useopenwrench.com to have a partner key issued.

## Required headers
Every request must carry BOTH `X-API-KEY` (your API key) and `OW-KEY` (the OpenWrench shared secret issued with it). Requests missing either return 401.

get.description: Health/authentication check. Returns a static "pong" payload when the supplied X-API-KEY is valid.

get.summary: Retrieve a purchase request by id
get.description: Retrieves a single purchase request belonging to the API key's supplier company, including its part and equipment line items.

Lists purchase requests visible to the API key's supplier company/facility. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

patch.description: Cancels a purchase request. Only purchase requests currently in a cancellable status ("requested" or "approved") can be cancelled; otherwise a 400 is returned. The caller's API key must belong to a contact associated with a facility of the purchase request's supplier company. Returns the updated purchase request.

Sets the status of a purchase request to the status given in the path. The caller's API key must belong to a contact associated with a facility of the purchase request's supplier company; otherwise a 400 is returned. An unrecognized status value is rejected. Returns the updated purchase request.

get.description: Returns the number of purchase request line items matching the supplied filters, scoped to the API key's supplier company/facility. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

Lists purchase request line items scoped to the API key's supplier company/facility. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

patch.summary: Associate PR line items with a PO line item
patch.description: Associates the purchase request line items identified by the comma-separated ids in the path with the given purchase order line item: each line item's status is set to "orderInProgress" and its associatedPurchaseOrderLineItemId is set to the poLineItem path value, and each parent purchase request's status is recomputed from its line items. Line item ids the API key has no read permission for are silently skipped. Returns the updated purchase request line items (possibly an empty list when nothing was permitted).

200.description: The updated purchase request line items

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated purchase request line item ids

parameters.name: poLineItem
parameters.description: Purchase order line item id to associate

post.description: Creates a purchase order together with its line items (incomingLineItems). supplierCompanyId and supplierFacilityId are derived from the contact associated with the API key; if the contact has no facility/company a 400 is returned. totalCost is required unless the supplier company's inventory settings mark PO cost as non-mandatory (mandatory by default). Returns the created purchase order.

get.description: Lists purchase orders visible to the API key's supplier company/facility. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

get.summary: Retrieve a purchase order by id
get.description: Retrieves a single purchase order belonging to the API key's supplier company, including its part and equipment line items.

patch.description: Cancels a purchase order. The caller's API key must belong to a contact of the purchase order's supplier company/facility; otherwise a 400 is returned. Returns the updated purchase order.

patch.summary: Mark a purchase order as ordered
patch.description: Transitions the purchase order to status "ordered" and sends the order notification email to the vendor. On success the response data is the confirmation string "Email has been sent" (type "Email"), not the updated purchase order.

post.description: Replaces the line items of a purchase order: all existing NON-received line items on the target purchase order are deleted, then the submitted line items are created. All items in one call must reference the same supplierPurchaseOrderId. Line item status cannot be set by the caller (new lines start as "new"; a line resubmitted with its id keeps its status). The purchase order's part/equipment/purchase-request id lists are recomputed from the submitted lines and the purchase order notification is re-sent. supplierFacilityId and supplierCompanyId on each item are derived from the API key. Returns the created line items; items the caller has no write permission for are silently skipped.

get.summary: Retrieve a purchase order receipt by id
get.description: Retrieves a single purchase order receipt belonging to the API key's supplier facility.

put.description: Updates a purchase order receipt (identified by id in the request body). On this endpoint updatedBy and supplierFacilityId must be supplied in the body — they are not derived from the API key. receivedQuantity must be non-zero (negative records a return); receipt-value arrays, when sent, must match receivedQuantity in length, may not accompany a return, and their serial/asset numbers must not already exist. Updating a receipt adjusts the received quantities/costs on the associated purchase order line item and stock records. Returns the updated receipt.

get.description: Retrieves a single part from the supplier's catalog.

Lists parts in the supplier company's catalog. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

get.summary: Retrieve a equipment type by id
get.description: Retrieves a single equipment type from the supplier's catalog.

Lists equipment types in the supplier company's catalog. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.
Retrieves a single part/equipment vendor.

Lists part/equipment vendors of the supplier facility. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

get.summary: Retrieve a stock location by id
get.description: Retrieves a single stock location.

Lists stock locations of the supplier company/facility. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

get.summary: Retrieve a parts per stock location by id
get.description: Retrieves a single part-at-stock-location stocking record (on-hand/reserved/available quantities, bin location, costs).

Lists part stocking records across the supplier's stock locations. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

get.summary: Retrieve a equipment per stock location by id
get.description: Retrieves a single piece of equipment held at a stock location (serial number, condition, provenance).

Lists equipment held across the supplier's stock locations. Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

get.summary: List parts and equipment used on a work order
get.description: Lists the part and equipment records consumed/used on the given work order, scoped to the API key's supplier tenant. Results are paginated. For partner API keys whose supplier company is not an internal-technician company, the embedded workOrder and location objects are masked (sensitive fields removed). Any query-string parameter other than the paging parameters is passed to the data layer as an equality filter on the corresponding entity column (e.g. `status=requested`, `stockLocationId=42`). Results are always restricted to the supplier company/facility associated with the API key.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY
ApiKeyAuth.description: Supplier partner API key. Rate limited to 10 requests per 20-second window.

OwKeyAuth.name: OW-KEY
OwKeyAuth.description: OpenWrench shared secret. Required on every request alongside X-API-KEY; issued together with your API key.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — invalid input, a disallowed state transition, the API key's contact is not associated with the required company/facility, or the key lacks read/write permission for the entity (permission failures are returned as 400 with type "unauthorizedException", not as 403)

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window per key)

type.description: Exception type, e.g. badRequestException, unauthorizedException, notFoundException

traceId.description: Server-generated trace identifier (11 alphanumeric characters) for support/debugging

AbridgedEntity.description: Nested hydrated entity whose full schema is not expanded in this spec (the shape is abridged). Present only when the record has the association hydrated.

StockLocation.description: A stock location (warehouse or mobile stock, e.g. a truck).

partsPerStockLocationAuditDTO.description: Audit metadata for the latest adjustment (abridged).

equipmentPerStockLocationAuditDTO.description: Audit metadata for the latest adjustment (abridged).

WorkOrderPartAndEquipment.description: A part or equipment record consumed/used on a work order. For external partner API keys not belonging to an internal-technician company, the embedded workOrder and location objects are masked (sensitive fields removed).

workOrder.description: Hydrated work order (abridged; masked for external partners).

location.description: Hydrated location (abridged; masked for external partners).

SupplierPurchaseOrderCreateRequest.description: Purchase order create payload (fields consumed by the server, verified from source). supplierCompanyId and supplierFacilityId are always derived from the API key's contact and override any values sent. The purchase order is created together with its line items (incomingLineItems). totalCost is additionally required unless the supplier company's inventory settings mark PO cost as non-mandatory (it is mandatory by default); a missing mandatory totalCost is rejected with 400 "Total cost of PO cannot be empty". Unknown fields are ignored.

id.description: Optional id of an existing purchase order; when supplied, that purchase order is loaded and its writable fields are replaced with this payload instead of creating a new one

status.description: Status of the purchase order, typically "new" on create

partEquipmentVendorId.description: Vendor the order is placed with

totalCost.description: Total cost of the PO. Required unless the supplier company's inventory settings mark PO cost as non-mandatory

createdByEmail.description: Email recorded as the creator of the purchase order

incomingLineItems.description: Line items to create with the purchase order; omitting it creates a PO with no line items

SupplierPurchaseOrderLineItemBulkItem.description: One purchase order line item to (re)create (fields consumed by the server, verified from source). supplierFacilityId and supplierCompanyId are derived from the API key and override any values sent. The line item's status cannot be set here: it is carried over from the existing line item when id is supplied, and defaults to "new" otherwise. stockLocationId/locationId are inherited from the purchase order. A cost (partCost or equipmentCost, matching the line type) is required unless the supplier company's inventory settings mark PO cost as non-mandatory (mandatory by default); a missing mandatory cost is rejected with 400 "PO Line Item cost cannot be empty". Unknown fields are ignored.

id.description: Optional id of an existing line item (its current status is preserved)

supplierPurchaseOrderId.description: Purchase order the line items belong to (must be the same PO for all items in the call)

isEquipmentLine.description: true for an equipment line, false for a part line

partUomId.description: Unit-of-measure id for the part line

equipmentUomId.description: Unit-of-measure id for the equipment line

prLineItemIds.description: Purchase request line item ids fulfilled by this PO line

SupplierPurchaseOrderReceiptUpdateReques.description: Purchase order receipt update payload (fields consumed by the server, verified from source). Supply id to identify the receipt being updated; when id is present the existing receipt's receivedBy, receivedOnWorkOrderCompletion and createdAt are preserved. NOTE: on this endpoint updatedBy and supplierFacilityId are read from the request body (they are not derived from the API key) and are required. receivedQuantity must be non-zero; a negative value records a return. When any of the receipt-value arrays is sent for a positive quantity, its length must equal receivedQuantity, none may be sent for a return (negative quantity), and serial/asset numbers must not already exist. Unknown fields are ignored.

id.description: Id of the receipt to update

receivedQuantity.description: Quantity received; must be non-zero. Negative records a return

updatedBy.description: Email recorded as the updater (also used as receivedBy for a new receipt)

equipmentPerStockLocationReceiptValues.description: Per-unit serial/asset numbers for received stock equipment; length must equal receivedQuantity

assetReceiptValues.description: Per-unit serial/asset numbers for received assets; length must equal receivedQuantity

receiptValuesWithoutId.description: Per-unit serial/asset numbers without an id; length must equal receivedQuantity
